# @polyms/ui-kit

> React 19 component library for product UI: compound components, semantic colors, and Tailwind CSS 4 utilities. This file is the index of knowledge for coding agents. Composition rules and the reading order live in the installed agent skill, not here.

Fetch a linked `.md` file for the component or guide you are changing. Do not open the HTML route without `.md`. When a symbol disagrees with the installed package, trust `node_modules/@polyms/ui-kit/index.d.ts`.

Point the `@polyms` scope at the Polyms registry. No token is required.

```ini
@polyms:registry=https://registry.polyms.dev/npm
```

```bash
pnpm add @polyms/ui-kit
```

Peers: `react` and `react-dom` `>=19`. Install `zustand` only when calling `useModalStore` or `useOffcanvasStore`. Import components from `@polyms/ui-kit` only. Load `@polyms/ui-kit/styles/tailwind.css`, or the installed `styles-<hash>.css`, once from the app entry.

<!-- llm-docs:start -->
## Changelog

- [Releases](https://ui.polyms.dev/releases.md): Changelog and breaking changes by version. Changelogs for each release of @polyms/ui-kit.

## Guides

- [AI Agent Skill](https://ui.polyms.dev/agent-skill.md): After you install @polyms/ui-kit, you can add a bundled agent skill so AI coding assistants — Cursor, Claude Code, and other tools that read AGENTS.md — compose UI the same way this library expects.
- [Design System](https://ui.polyms.dev/design-system.md): Polyms UI Kit (@polyms/ui-kit) is a React component library for product UI: semantic colors, compound components, CSS utilities, and dark mode.
- [Design Tokens](https://ui.polyms.dev/design-tokens.md): Polyms UI Kit exposes color, type, elevation, motion, and stacking as CSS custom properties.
- [Installation](https://ui.polyms.dev/installation.md): Polyms UI Kit is published as @polyms/ui-kit.
- [Typography](https://ui.polyms.dev/typography.md): Polyms UI Kit ships a heading scale as CSS classes (h1–h6) with Tailwind CSS 4 for size, weight, and alignment utilities.

## Components

- [Accordion](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/accordion.md): Expand and collapse sections with Accordion, Accordion.Item, Header, Trigger, and Panel.
- [Alert](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/alert.md): Provide contextual feedback messages for typical user actions with a handful of available and flexible alert messages.
- [Avatar](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/avatar.md): Displays a user's profile picture, initials, or fallback icon.
- [Badge](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/badge.md): Small status and label chips.
- [Breadcrumb](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/breadcrumb.md): Display the current page's location within a navigational hierarchy.
- [Button](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/button.md): Trigger an action or event, such as submitting a Form, opening a Dialog, canceling an action, or performing a delete operation in React.
- [Card](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/card.md): Simple content container.
- [Checkbox](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/checkbox.md): Use Checkbox for binary choices, agreements, and parent rows with mixed state.
- [Chip](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/chip.md): Chips represent compact values such as skills, categories, or recipients.
- [Collapsible](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/collapsible.md): Expandable container that shows and hides content.
- [Dark mode](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/dark-mode.md): Class-based dark mode for @polyms/ui-kit.
- [Dynamic import](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/dynamic.md): Wrap React.lazy and Suspense for code-split routes, heavy widgets, or federated remotes.
- [Field](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/field.md): A flexible form field wrapper that combines labels, inputs, descriptions, and validation feedback into a cohesive component.
- [Interactive items](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/item.md): Ghost-style interactive utilities for nav items, list rows, and menu entries.
- [Link](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/link.md): Text links and “clickable card” pattern.
- [Menu](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/menu.md): Menus display a list of actions or options triggered by a button.
- [mergeProps](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/merge-props.md): mergeProps combines multiple React prop objects when you wrap or compose elements.
- [Modal](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/modal.md): Modals display focused content in a layer above the main interface, requiring user interaction before proceeding.
- [Navigation Menu](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/navigation-menu.md): Navigation Menu is a multi-item navigation surface for site headers and mega menus.
- [Number Field](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/number-field.md): Number fields let users enter numeric values with precision.
- [Offcanvas](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/offcanvas.md): Offcanvas panels slide in from the edge of the viewport to display supplementary content, navigation menus, or settings.
- [Popover](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/popover.md): Popovers display rich content in a floating panel when triggered by user interaction.
- [Radio](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/radio.md): Use RadioGroup and Radio when exactly one option should be selected.
- [Select](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/select.md): Allow users to choose one or multiple options from a dropdown list.
- [Skeleton](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/skeleton.md): Loading placeholder blocks.
- [Spinner](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/spinner.md): A loading indicator that provides visual feedback to users during asynchronous operations.
- [Switch](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/switch.md): Toggle between two mutually exclusive states, typically on and off.
- [Table](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/table.md): Style data tables with semantic HTML and utility classes.
- [Tabs](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/tabs.md): Organize and navigate between related content groups without leaving the page.
- [Toast](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/toast.md): Display brief, non-blocking feedback messages to users about the outcome of an action or system event.
- [Toc](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/toc.md): Anchor readers to the sections on the current page.
- [Toggle](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/toggle.md): A two-state button that can be on or off.
- [Toolbar](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/toolbar.md): A container for grouping a related set of buttons, toggles, links, and inputs.
- [Tooltip](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/tooltip.md): Display brief, contextual information when users hover or focus on an element.
- [useRender](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/use-render.md): useRender powers the render prop on Button, Field, Breadcrumb, Modal, and other components.
- [Z-index](https://ui.polyms.dev/docs/z-index.md): Named stacking helpers backed by --zindex-* CSS variables.
<!-- llm-docs:end -->
